sessions.focus: New user signup blocked by trigger chain, pricing page dark mode

whatChanged.title: Root cause:
whatChanged.detail: `sync_profile_to_lawyer()` ran on EVERY profile INSERT (clients included) with unqualified `UPDATE lawyers`. In Supabase Auth's session context, `public` is not in the search_path → "relation 'lawyers' does not exist" → transaction rollback → "Database error creating new user".

whatChanged.title: Fix 1:
whatChanged.detail: Role-gated `sync_profile_to_lawyer()` to `'lawyer'`/`'admin'` only + qualified `public.lawyers` prefix to survive any search_path context.

whatChanged.title: Fix 2:
whatChanged.detail: `handle_new_user()` deployed version was missing the `full_name` COALESCE fallback chain (only had direct `->>'full_name'`). Added fallback: `full_name` → `name` (Google OAuth field) → `split_part(email, '@', 1)`.

whatChanged.title: Fix 3:
whatChanged.detail: `handle_new_user()` now also splits `full_name` into `first_name`/`last_name` (splits on first space) — previously only set `full_name`, leaving `first_name`/`last_name` NULL for new users.

whatChanged.title: Fix 4:
whatChanged.detail: Email signup `emailRedirectTo` had `/directory/auth/callback` instead of `/auth/callback` — middleware already rewrites, causing double prefix on production.

whatChanged.title: Fix 5:
whatChanged.detail: Auth callback route `redirectTo` had same double `/directory` prefix issue.

whatChanged.title: Dark mode:
whatChanged.detail: Pricing page cards, tabs, notice section, and payment buttons now render with yellow-toned colors in dark mode for proper visibility.

rationale: New user signups were completely broken — anyone attempting to create an account (email, Google OAuth, or admin API) would get "Database error creating new user." The `sync_profile_to_lawyer()` trigger was the culprit: it ran in the auth session context where `public` is not in the search_path, causing an unresolvable table reference. The role gate also prevents unnecessary `lawyers` table writes for client accounts.
files: `schema.sql` — `handle_new_user()` synced with COALESCE fallback + first_name/last_name split

sessions.focus: Tobi's report: "email login doesn't work, only Google works."

whatChanged.title: Root cause (two bugs, one report)
whatChanged.detail: (1) Tobi's account is Google-identity-only with no password, so `signInWithPassword` always failed — and our error said "Incorrect email or password", a dead end; (2) the Brevo auth-email hook built `/auth/v1/verify` URLs on the **app domain**, which 404s — GoTrue hosts verify on the Supabase project domain (proved via `admin/generate_link` ground truth).

whatChanged.title: Fixes
whatChanged.detail: `lib/auth/oauth-account.ts` detects OAuth-only accounts after a failed login/signup and points users at the provider + the set-password path; `app/api/auth/hook/route.ts` always builds verify URLs on `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`.

whatChanged.title: Deployed
whatChanged.detail: commit `05caa76` → pushed → Vercel production (SHA verified against live deployment); `check:migrations` clean (40, in sync).

whatChanged.title: Industry grounding
whatChanged.detail: (researched): Auth0 keeps identities separate by default, Clerk auto-links on verified email both-sides, Google says key on `sub` not email, Ory/WorkOS document pre-account-takeover from unverified-email auto-linking — so: tell them which provider owns the account + set-password from an authenticated surface, never blind auto-merge.

rationale: A user with no password cannot be told "wrong password" — the message must name the real fix. The hook fix was on the critical path because "Forgot your password?" is how a Google-only user sets their first password.
